equation_scope: Equation 10.1 states a median non-additivity inequality, not a complete median-filter kernel or boundary rule.
Equation 10.2 prints 1/(1+(x+y)^2), and Equation 10.3 has an s-1 lower summation index; neither is silently replaced with a conventional texture formula.
Equation 10.11 ends with multiplication by T0 rather than an unambiguous percentage conversion, so the printed F-score definition is not used as a validated implementation.
evaluation_boundary: Only printed metrics and figure values were compared. Selected image IDs, patient-level assignments, raw masks, class labels, confusion counts, predictions, fitted models, seeds, and external validation are unavailable; swapped plot labels cannot be reconciled into two validated dataset results.
brain_cancer_relevance: No brain-tumor cohort, brain delivery, molecular target, target engagement, toxicity result, treatment outcome, or survival evidence is supplied.
